degree_rationale: Five Forms hidden in the body of the archon (lion-head, eagle-wings, fish-tail, etc.) corresponding to the five worlds of darkness. Essence-iconography of the dark cosmic body.
direction_rationale: West-turn at the celestial: the essences are now embodied in the outermost figures — the dark archon's body completed in its visible composite. Setting/ultimating of celestial form.
grand_man_function: Celestial outermost — the embodied dark figure as seal of the celestial counter-form.
title: Five Forms hidden in the body that correspond to the archons of darkness
